title: Show when each document was last opened on the library list
objective: On the library list, show when each document was last opened under its title, in an element with data-testid="last-opened" inside each row, like "Last opened 2 days ago", or "Not opened yet" when nobody has opened it. Any open counts. Relative to the store clock: under an hour reads "N minutes ago" ("just now" under a minute), under a day "N hours ago", otherwise "N days ago", whole units rounded down, singular for 1. Also return lastOpenedAt (ISO or null) on each document in GET /api/documents.
acceptance: d1 (last open 2 hours before the clock) reads "Last opened 2 hours ago"
d3 reads "Last opened 6 days ago" and d4 "Last opened 10 days ago"
d5, never opened, reads "Not opened yet"
Singular units and "just now" read correctly
GET /api/documents returns lastOpenedAt for each document, null when never opened
plan_summary: A relativeTime(now, then) helper in format.mjs; a lastOpenedAt(docId) query in store.mjs used by the page and the API summary.
